title: Zhang Qian and the Silk Road
subtitle: 考点：历史人物 / brave, pioneer, the Western Regions
passage: More than two thousand years ago, Zhang Qian lived in the Han Dynasty. The emperor sent him to the Western Regions to look for friends for his country. The trip was long and dangerous. On the way, Zhang Qian was caught and kept for about ten years, but he never gave up his mission.

At last he escaped and went on. When he came home, he told the emperor about the countries, the roads and the goods in the west. After his trip, traders began to travel along the Silk Road. Silk and paper went west, and new ideas came east. Today people remember Zhang Qian as a brave pioneer.
